decisive_items: lytic lesions in the sternum, right humerus, and thoracic vertebrae
response.rationale: Multiple myeloma is supported by the presence of lytic bone lesions and anemia, while lymphoma is also a consideration due to mediastinal lymphadenopathy and hypermetabolic lymph nodes, but the combination of findings leans more towards multiple myeloma

rejected.why: Normal-sized uterus and ovaries with no masses or cysts on ultrasound contradict the PET-CT findings suggestive of ovarian malignancy
